overview_description.description: Redbean develops an AI-powered platform that combines generative artificial intelligence with casual gaming and interactive storytelling. The company offers a no-code environment where users create original characters and pixel art worlds from text prompts, sketches, or custom descriptions. Its core mobile app functions as both a cozy life simulator and a simple game builder, enabling users to design towns, set up narrative scenarios, and explore them in playable form. Non-player characters are guided by language models to react to context, show emotions, remember past interactions, and maintain continuity in conversations. Redbean serves writers, digital roleplayers, and first-time creators who want to build, remix, and share stories without traditional game development skills. The platform also supports sharing of created scenes and experiences across social channels.
